review_type: Independent read-only Forms Stage2 implementation and regression plan; not implementation acceptance

copy_status.note: Tracked target deletions pre-existed this plan. No source restoration, staging, cleanup or deletion performed.

diagnosis.finding: Both linear and lane update paths queue a focused-field reveal on every update, then queue a Radio cursor reveal again. ScrollRegion wheel movement can therefore be undone during the following prepared layout even when focus/caret did not change.

TextArea independently ensures its child scroll contains the caret and scrolls horizontally on every editing update. Its caret_source_row accessor supplies only a saturated source row, not cursor column or edit-follow intent. A Form-only row cache cannot prove frozen same-row movement/edit and nested child-wheel behavior.
TextAction omits navigation-only moves; Response.changed includes pointer mechanics. Neither is an adequate automatic-follow trigger by itself.

frozen_contract.evidence: ScrollView caches Followed { focus, target } in logical content coordinates; equal target returns without reveal. Priority is actual caret, then fitting focused control, then tall control gutter/first cell. Missing target clears cache. Parent scroll offset is not part of target.
Same focused clipped control after manual offset change stays at manual offset; changed focus follows. Changed list gutter row in a tall control follows.

Child follows only when editing and follow_cursor requested, actual cursor changed, or resized. Manual scrolling persists until cursor motion/editing. Right and paste restore visibility; resize preserves long Unicode caret visibility.

phase_2a_fields_owner.contract: TextArea alone owns document editing and child scroll follow. Capture a pure logical caret descriptor and a follow request identity from its actual editor operations; do not make Form inspect EditBuffer, consume raw key bindings, or duplicate pointer/edit logic.
phase_2a_fields_owner.minimal_api_decision: First demonstrate whether cursor row+column+editing transition and the existing typed outcome suffice for all frozen probes. If an edit-follow request cannot be observed without duplicating editor mechanics, add a small additive read-only descriptor carrying logical source caret, movement/edit-follow revision, and validity. Keep its document positions distinct from physical parent clipping. Do not expose mutable buffer or broaden TextAction semantics merely to transport geometry.
trigger_rules: Beginning a real edit/focus session, actual cursor/selection navigation, accepted text edits/paste, actual pointer caret placement, and genuine logical child viewport resize may request child follow. Source the exact list from frozen editor operations and tests.

Wheel/track drag, hover, ticks, settlement and repeat update with identical editing state must not request follow. A physical parent window changing first_source_row or visible height must not masquerade as child resize.
Keep coordinate actions dependent on valid prepared geometry; keyboard/lifecycle input must remain available while a parent-clipped body is not rendered. Do not synthesize registrations/cursors.
Edit command API and menu-dispatched edits must use the same editor-owned request mechanism. Stage3 menu layout/routing remains separate.
phase_2a_fields_owner.compatibility: Retain existing caret_source_row, public constructors, text actions, state ownership and zeroization. Any added private state participates in Clone/Eq/Debug/reset/cancel/sensitivity transitions as appropriate; it contains no secret text.

phase_2b_forms_owner.contract: FormState alone owns automatic parent follow history, keyed by stable focused field Id and stable lane/scroll owner Id plus logical target kind/span/caret identity. Derive targets after the existing child update from the same pure placement plan used to resolve windows. Use one helper for linear and lane cases.
phase_2b_forms_owner.target_priority: Explicit FormState::reveal request has documented one-shot precedence. Otherwise actual focused editing caret descriptor; focused Radio cursor/gutter row; fitting focused control span; tall focused control first/gutter row. Preserve frozen behavior with tests rather than assuming the current bottom-only reveal_index is an exact span implementation.
phase_2b_forms_owner.geometry_identity: Use logical placement and actual logical viewport dimensions/width/reflow/lane identity. Exclude scroll offset, translated visible Rect, first_source_row, clipped child window, pointer position, update cause and time. Existing layout facts/plans should suffice; do not add a second runtime/layout system.
update_order: Read valid resolved logical layout and update each existing ScrollRegion once.
Reconcile and update the actual child once; collect the active logical follow target and editor-owned request identity.

Compare against previous automatic follow record; queue a reveal only for a changed target, genuine geometry invalidation requiring follow, or explicit request. Do not queue a stale generic field reveal before a more specific target.

Store comparison state only in update, never draw/measure. Keep pending reveal scheduling in existing ScrollState. Preserve logical request while viewport zero; do not mark an unapplied target as fulfilled accidentally.
phase_2b_forms_owner.span_note: ScrollState currently only queues one index. If a public probe shows bottom-only reveal loses the frozen full fitting-control span, implement the missing span operation once in the collection scrolling owner and use it from Form; do not build an application-local scroll routine.
lifecycle: Clear stale records when focused owner disappears, field kind/state is replaced or field is hidden; preserve stable identity across reorder/lane reflow without associating history with an index.

Record actual focus transitions, including covered layer and restoration, using runtime ownership. Do not register an offscreen control to force focus/cursor; test existing runtime policy before promising it.
Include new private history in FormState Clone/Eq/Debug and clear it in reset/zeroize paths. Explicit validation reveal remains effective even for the same owner.

Viewport-only resize behavior needs a source-backed differential probe: frozen parent cache is focus+target, not an unconditional resize generation. Do not add a forced parent re-center on every resize without evidence. Child genuine resize follow is explicit in frozen source.

approved_plan.serialization: Finish and review the Fields contract first if needed, then implement Form integration on that exact tip. One writer per component family; no concurrent changes to textarea.rs. No runtime input duplication or application painter changes.

required_regressions.fixture: Real public Form and lane Form, focus actual editable field through hit/Tab; wheel parent track/thumb with controlled wheel_rows=1.
required_regressions.assertions: Offset changes and remains after repeated update, tick, hover, settle and draw. Assert actual TEXT cells/source rows and cursor absence when clipped. RED ae32 then GREEN same source.

required_regressions.fixture: After parent manual scroll, move Right on same source row; move vertically; type/paste; selection/navigation and actual pointer placement.
required_regressions.assertions: Follow only real editor requests, correct original document edited, caret/hit/source row consistent. Pure row-only dedup must fail at least the same-row case.

required_regressions.fixture: Long multiline document in taller logical TextArea clipped by short Form and each lane. Wheel child text and its scrollbar independently from parent.
required_regressions.assertions: Child/parent offsets remain independent; child manual scroll persists until real caret/edit request; no re-follow loop as parent offset changes; check thumb partial clipping.

required_regressions.fixture: Fitting/tall fields, Radio cursor changes, Tab/ShiftTab, focus away/back, modal cover/restore, stable reordered fields and lanes, validation reveal twice.
required_regressions.assertions: Changed target follows once; unchanged target does not; explicit reveal is not overwritten; no background or phantom focus registration.

required_regressions.fixture: Actual Harness resize before next input; adjacent width/height, zero->nonzero, lane split/reflow, parent window top/bottom clipping.
required_regressions.assertions: Geometry refreshed before coordinate input; pending reveal not lost at zero viewport; logical row/caret correct; viewport resize behavior matched to frozen, not assumed.

required_regressions.fixture: Unicode wide/combining, long horizontal text, empty, secret/read-only/disabled, narrow0/1 cells; repeated measure/draw.
required_regressions.assertions: No panic/leak; no validators/domain mutations or input execution in measure/draw; one cursor only within actual rendered TEXT; original value and selection mechanics retained.
